predicate: Material plant-performance claim relies on generation incompatible with all measured energy inputs
semantic_novelty_or_rejection: R13 compares fuel/emissions; N09 compares company output with national production. This tests a conversion balance, not a peer-efficiency benchmark.
discriminating_evidence_and_next_check: Exact physical boundary, full consumed-energy inputs, lower output/upper input bounds and current corrections; reject hybrid/storage/imported-heat ambiguity.

predicate: Evapotranspiration greater than rainfall proves illegal pumping
semantic_novelty_or_rejection: ET also reflects stored soil water, groundwater and authorized irrigation; GRACE scale is not field pumping.
discriminating_evidence_and_next_check: Need measured abstraction, rights, soil/storage and inflows; reject rainfall-only subtraction as a legal test.

predicate: Arms inventory change fails deliveries-minus-losses balance
semantic_novelty_or_rejection: SIPRI transfer estimates and UNROCA reports do not establish opening stocks, domestic production, losses or complete coverage.
discriminating_evidence_and_next_check: Obtain actual weapon-unit stocks and all flows; no conversion of SIPRI trend-indicator values to weapon counts.

predicate: Adding displacement flows and refugee stocks proves inflated beneficiary numbers
semantic_novelty_or_rejection: Movements, persons and point-in-time stocks are different units; repeated displacement is real.
discriminating_evidence_and_next_check: Define unique-person population and dates with coverage before reconciliation; no individual identity data acquired.

predicate: Same ship has two purported current national registrations
semantic_novelty_or_rejection: IMO may anchor identity, but charter registration, suspension and different registry roles defeat a naive flag conflict.
discriminating_evidence_and_next_check: Need historical official instruments establishing simultaneously operative incompatible status; Equasis snapshot is not enough.

predicate: Two ASNs announce one prefix therefore one stole it
semantic_novelty_or_rejection: Multiple-origin announcements can be authorized, including transition and anycast arrangements.
discriminating_evidence_and_next_check: Need holder authorization, routing-security evidence and dated configuration; RDAP ownership alone does not settle origin legitimacy.

predicate: Same frequency and overlapping service geometry mean unlawfully duplicated licences
semantic_novelty_or_rejection: Frequency reuse, antenna patterns, power, time, service and coordination conditions matter.
discriminating_evidence_and_next_check: Obtain exact operative licence terms and engineering interference evidence; point overlap is not exclusivity.

predicate: Two issuers claim exclusive ownership of the same mineral right
semantic_novelty_or_rejection: Refines Z04 incompatible exclusive grants and X09 title assertions; changing asset type does not add a mechanism.
discriminating_evidence_and_next_check: Same jurisdiction, tenure number, right type, depth/commodity, effective dates and chain; different provinces or surface/mineral interests are not conflicting rights.

predicate: Payment preceding goods delivery proves improper procurement
semantic_novelty_or_rejection: Advance/mobilization payments may be expressly allowed; milestone due dates are not actual delivery dates.
discriminating_evidence_and_next_check: Read payment clause, security and amendments; discard blanket pay-after-delivery assumption.

predicate: First participant enrollment precedes required ethics approval
semantic_novelty_or_rejection: Another required-approval-before-action predicate; registry start date may be estimated and publication ethics text incomplete.
discriminating_evidence_and_next_check: Actual first enrollment, original approval/version and applicable local rule or waiver required; no generic global deadline.

predicate: Arms delivery before a DSCA announcement proves unauthorized export
semantic_novelty_or_rejection: Announcements, approvals, commercial licences, earlier cases, amendments and deliveries are not one universal sequence.
discriminating_evidence_and_next_check: Require exact transmittal/licence and shipment identity plus applicable regime; aggregate country/system match is insufficient.

predicate: Withdrawal made before a project-specific disbursement condition was satisfied
semantic_novelty_or_rejection: Useful X07 prerequisite variant, not a new formulation merely because action is disbursement.
discriminating_evidence_and_next_check: Original financing condition, category, bank notice, waiver and actual withdrawal effective date; project approval or headline commitment is not withdrawal.

predicate: File-specific no-conflict statement versus a dated private interest tied to the matter
semantic_novelty_or_rejection: Refines H04 and REF-REL disclosure consistency; actual official role and interest must connect to this file.
discriminating_evidence_and_next_check: Member ID/procedure → signed file-specific statement → verified company/role/interest dates; no generic employer-name inference.

predicate: Procurement decision maker benefits through the selected supplier
semantic_novelty_or_rejection: Role-versus-beneficiary overlap is the related-party decision-maker predicate E08, not new simply in procurement.
discriminating_evidence_and_next_check: Actual decision authority and beneficial interest at decision date; same address or officer name is insufficient; declaration/recusal rules separate.

predicate: Charity trustee connected to grantee
semantic_novelty_or_rejection: Already covered by E08 related-party transactions.
discriminating_evidence_and_next_check: Retain jurisdiction-specific reporting rules for future implementation, but do not create another card from source substitution.

predicate: Listed lobbyist simultaneously holds an incompatible parliamentary role
semantic_novelty_or_rejection: Register contact names do not prove employment duties or incompatibility; paid/outside roles and rules differ.
discriminating_evidence_and_next_check: Exact person identity, actual role dates and operative restriction plus permission; no name-only accusation.

predicate: Independent completed reimbursements charged to the same eligible cost exceed its permitted funding
semantic_novelty_or_rejection: N01 reconciles aid accounts; Z01 bid rates; X02 unpaid obligations. This tests duplicate cost recovery after reconstructing the money path.
discriminating_evidence_and_next_check: Original cost item and financing cap; independent settled payments net of refunds, not mirrored donor/recipient entries or pass-through transfers.

predicate: Two offset claims consume the same carbon-credit units
semantic_novelty_or_rejection: Issuer claims and snapshots do not establish serial-level issuance/retirement rights. No registry crosswalk established in this batch.
discriminating_evidence_and_next_check: Acquire exact registry, unit serial interval, vintage, beneficiary and claim text; resale, scope and revisions matter. Supporting registry required before a card.

predicate: Two grants credited for one paper proves duplicate reimbursement
semantic_novelty_or_rejection: Multiple grants can lawfully support one output; acknowledgement is not cost accounting.
discriminating_evidence_and_next_check: Actual same charged cost, funded share and prohibition required; use B02 only if that evidence exists, not publication counts.

predicate: Two parties claim the same exclusive renewable-power attribute
semantic_novelty_or_rejection: Underlying electricity, certificates and environmental claims can be separate rights; exclusivity overlap refines Z04.
discriminating_evidence_and_next_check: Exact certificate serials or unique metered MWh and contract attribute clauses; same generator/year is not the same right.

predicate: An expressly serviceable vessel is documented as lost before the claim date
semantic_novelty_or_rejection: Precise operational assertion versus established finding refines P05; mere continuing registry entry makes no serviceability claim.
discriminating_evidence_and_next_check: Final occurrence facts, exact vessel identity, salvage/reconstruction and representation date; no all-registry-is-active assumption.

predicate: Exact no-fossil-input generation claim versus recorded fuel consumption
semantic_novelty_or_rejection: Fuel/energy/emissions representation specialization; no separate formulation counted.
discriminating_evidence_and_next_check: Claim may concern contracted attributes or net accounting rather than physical inputs; match site, interval and explicit scope.

predicate: Completed physical asset claim versus incompatible dated site evidence
semantic_novelty_or_rejection: Already represented by physical-inventory and precise-assertion methods.
discriminating_evidence_and_next_check: Optical nonvisibility is not nonexistence; exact claimed date, footprint and construction stage required.

predicate: Assessment claims no relevant species records despite a verified occurrence
semantic_novelty_or_rejection: C13 already tests omitted scoped occurrences.
discriminating_evidence_and_next_check: Taxon, observation quality, coordinate uncertainty, survey cutoff and legal relevance; no sensitive coordinates disclosed.
